newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: FIATA to debate liability standards at congress.
newsitem.headline: FIATA to debate liability standards at congress.

text.p: FIATA (International Federation of Freight Forwarders Associations) will debate the need for global liability standards at its 25th annual congress which opened on Monday, delegates said.
A total of 450 delegates from 76 countries meeting for the fist time in Latin America will hear a report on the issue during the four-day forum.
Experts from FIATA -- which represents freight forwarders organizations in 141 countries -- say internationally recognized liability standards covering multimodal transport services do not exist.

FIATA President Brian Kelleher insisted this year that a clear framework was urgently neede because world transport was getting increasingly global and incorporating more countries with little experience in the matter.

He obliquely said at the opening ceremony Monday that some of these countries were in Latin America and deplored that "in the past FIATA has not been close enough to Latin America." He pledged to correct this.
